title: Circuit Breakers & Graceful Degradation
learningObjectives: Implement the three-state Circuit Breaker pattern: CLOSED, OPEN, and HALF_OPEN
Track failure thresholds, timeout frequencies, and cooldown recovery windows
Design graceful fallbacks when dependencies fail (cached responses, default states)
keyTradeoffs: Failing fast with an immediate fallback error vs waiting on upstream connection timeouts
Shared distributed circuit breaker state vs local per-process circuit breaker state
commonPitfalls: Setting trip thresholds too sensitive, causing cascading circuit trips during momentary network blips
Treating 4xx client errors as upstream service failures that trip the breaker
transferPrompt: How do client-side retry strategies collaborate with circuit breakers without amplifying upstream outages?
